name: Iceman - Ice To Meet You All
description_md:
Just played a variation of this deck against Expert Magneto! 

Replay of the stream is here (timestamped to game start): https://www.youtube.com/live/-Tk1CaYl1vU?si=oYgNM6jhWKd7UVUS&t=12430

This is a control deck - Lets Trigger Freeze as many times as we can.

He wants to get his [Cryokinetic Perception](/card/46005) out as soon as possible to get some card draw, use [Superpower Training](/card/40059) to find it, or mulligan hard. Once this is out we have a potential ready every round once with "Freeze" if we can hit an Ice Card.

But that's not all...

The other key piece to this deck is [Utopia](/card/33020) and [Uncanny X-Men](/card/36018), since Iceman gets to ready when an Xmen ally enters play he can trigger his Freeze ability yet again

This allows us to hit that freeze ability 2-3 times every round giving the villain -3/-3 to their stats.

The main ally we want to play is [Mirage](/card/36015) - since she can sun a villain with a Sch value less than her thw we can hit this super constantly since [Frostbite](/card/46002) lowers the sch value of the attached enemy.

When the villain is stunned they do not activate and therefore our [Frostbite](/card/46002)s are preserved allowing us to flip safely and shuffle in our Ice cards since we have so many Frostbites out!

Use [Make the Call](/card/01071) and [Pixie](/card/36017) to keep the villain stunned, flip every other turn and trigger all our awesome mutant supports

Then Profit!
